digest.component_or_area: store-epoch guard in sync and push
propositions: A stale clone with mismatched or missing epochs must refuse to union diverged histories instead of silently re-unioning stripped history
The epoch guard must be placed in sync._union_merge and before non-fast-forward merges in push_tickets_branch to cover both union paths (sync path and review-bot write path)
The epoch is stored as a JSON string field in .store-compat.json; older binaries ignore unknown keys and remain safe; corrupt or non-string epochs trigger abort

The state matrix defines nine rows of compatibility rules: absent-absent and absent-present-epoch-absent are compatible; mismatched epochs abort; remote-unreadable must be distinguished from remote-absent in error messages

On epoch mismatch at sync._union_merge return without merging to leave the clone un-converged; at push.py return from push_tickets_branch immediately to abort retry and leave push not-completed without invoking merge or re-push

After a guard-aborted non-fast-forward push fsck must report DIVERGED (not PUSH_PENDING) with local and remote refs byte-for-byte unchanged; behind clones with matching epochs still converge via ff-adopt
